title: Resolve Telegram intents against the live catalog
requirements: Add a pure TelegramActionResolver that accepts only an exact validated TelegramIntent and returns a ChannelAction. Revalidate TELEGRAM ChannelContext and exact intent shapes. OPEN, HELP, RESET and SUBMIT require an empty immutable payload and map directly to the same ChannelAction. TEXT_INPUT never maps speculatively and returns a safe typed TelegramActionError with code SCREEN_REQUIRED.

Resolve SELECT_SERVICE only from its exact integer payload catalog_version and option_ordinal and an explicit live catalog mapping. Validate non-boolean catalog_version in 1..2147483647, services as a list, every service as a mapping with an options list, every option active marker as absent/True/False, and every active option id as a normalized non-empty string of at most 100 characters. Reject duplicate active option ids and malformed catalog shapes as CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE without returning catalog data.

Flatten active options in the exact service and option order received. Require the live catalog_version to equal the callback version or return STALE_CATALOG. Resolve zero-based option_ordinal only within that active list or return UNKNOWN_SERVICE_SELECTION. Return ChannelAction SELECT_SERVICE with only service_option_id; never trust or pass catalog version, ordinal, raw callback, price, status, sender or other catalog fields into the action.

TelegramActionError str/repr is stable and contains no intent payload, option id, catalog data or trusted identifiers. The resolver is deterministic and side-effect free: it does not call ChannelConversation/Gateway, mutate catalog, retain data, render copy, load environment, log, access HTTP/SDK/persistence or perform delivery/retry/external calls.

Add direct exhaustive pure tests for wrong intent/exact type/context/kind and forged payloads; every direct mapping; TEXT_INPUT rejection; catalog/version/structure/active/id/duplicate failures; stable ordered flattening with inactive options; ordinal/version boundaries; immutable inputs; output exactness; safe errors and zero side effects. Copy this exact contract from primary .pipeline/TG-007-spec.json to tasks/specs/TG-007.json.
acceptance: Only an intent resolved against the matching current catalog can select a concrete service option; stale or malformed callbacks cannot choose another option.
Direct commands become strict ChannelAction values while free text remains explicitly deferred to screen-aware handling.
Focused resolver tests, interaction/update regressions, complete project tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted pure catalog resolver between the reviewed Telegram intent protocol and shared conversation actions.
